descriptions.notStarted: I showed the #bCoded Communique#k to Elpam Gorlab, and he recognized the symbols as being #bVersalian#k!  Elpam translated what he could and gave me a #bTranslated Communique#k.  I should show this to John immediately!
descriptions.inProgress: I must traverse Crimsonwood Mountain and get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...!
descriptions.completed: I reached Jack and gave him the info-he's going through it all now...
